correctness.rationale: Every one-relocation transports exactly one gap unit, giving the L1/2 lower bound. Pair all donor-to-recipient units; left-moving transfers weakly increase every Dyck prefix, and remaining right transfers preserve all target prefix bounds because each prefix surplus equals its outstanding right-crossing transfers. Thus the bound is attained for arbitrary pairs. Both graph diameters are at most n-1 since every word begins with an opening step, while the run-count gap from mountain to alternating requires n-1 arbitrary-symbol relocations. Independently constructed BFS graphs and constructive paths were exhaustively checked for all 203455 ordered pairs through semilength 7.
